title: I Have Something Important to Tell You
author: KnightAnNi

file.url: https://www.ifarchive.org/if-archive/games/mini-comps/neo-twinyjam/2024/I Have Something Important to Tell You.zip

description:
I have something important to tell you. It's about depression.

First, I will pretend that you are my five-year-old child, telling you why mommy takes a pill every morning.

Then, I will write down all the things I don't say to you as a five-year-old.
